claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings provide validated complementary views (citation heritage recovery AUC 0.79-0.85, section cross-lingual alignment for facts/holdings, linear hybrid complement PASS adversarial gates) at 144k scale (22yr, 2000-2021). They do NOT replace TF-IDF citation hybrids for primary jurist navigation (true OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 vs factory target 0.7, TF-IDF baseline JP 0.78). Full 174k completion and production integration of dense views require corpus lane resumption (bge_/bger_ ID mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction at scale, 2022-2023 quality validation).
evidence_summary: Independently verified 7 primary evidence files: citation_heritage_22year_latest.json (4 dense variants AUC 0.7916-0.7946, 344 pos/500 neg pairs, 144k decisions), section_crosslingual_eval_latest.json (Sachverhalt cp64 cross_lang=0.282>0.2 PASS, Dispositiv 0.150>0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen 0.094<0.1 FAIL at 1K sample), weight_sweep_22year_latest.json (linear w=0.4 JP=0.6725/LangDom=0.6539 PASS, w=0.3 hybrid05 JP=0.6115/LangDom=0.7477 PASS, TF-IDF baselines JP=0.784/0.789), linear_citation_concat_22year_eval_latest.json and linear_hybrid05_concat_22year_eval_latest.json (full adversarial + cross-lingual + jurist usability), all_experiments_results.json (legal_tfidf_bge: baseline 14/14 PASS, 5 legal variants 6-8/14 FAIL, citation heritage AUC ~0.5), progress.json (2021,2022,2023 flagged FAILED, 2024-2026 missing), v8_holdout_zero_shot_validation_report.md (holdout 200 decisions: JP 0.51-0.56 vs full 0.69-0.80, confirming true OOS ceiling ~0.53). All 10+ negative results preserved (dense JP fail all scales, OOS ceiling <0.7, legal TF-IDF fail, hierarchy fail, boilerplate fail, cross-lingual recall <0.2, Erwaegungen cross-lingual fail, 2022-2023 embeddings failed). No leakage concealment, benchmark gaming, or prettiness-as-quality detected. Product contracts conservative: primary=TF-IDF PRODUCTION v1.0, citation_heritage=READY v1.1+, cross_lingual=BLOCKED v1.1+, hybrid=EXPLORATORY v1.1+.
